recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future recurrence appears, investigate the active publisher/tooling pipeline rather than adding redundant profile prose or changing resource semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17663 asked that each profile parsed from a tabbed profile spreadsheet render its own title instead of sharing the same title across all tabs; the Jira resolution was to grab the title from the short name of the root element.
initial_application: No current repository commit explicitly mentions FHIR-17663. The 2020-01-27 FHIR-I minutes record Lloyd saying the issue was already fixed before the persuasive vote, and later source history preserved distinct StructureDefinition.title values.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread frames the problem as core tooling/rendering behavior. The current Observation resource folder is in build scope through source/fhir.ini, and current profile XML sources for bodyheight, vitalsigns, bmi, bp, and sibling profiles have distinct title values. Current build.fhir.org profile JSON for representative affected profiles also returns distinct titles.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current source and current rendered/build surface already satisfy the requested behavior.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the linked Zulip thread as a profile example, but its Jira scope is body height clinical guidance rather than this title-rendering tooling behavior. It was not decided here.
